integrity: The stated analytic theorem has a self-review and a standalone reproducibility script; no independent external audit, expert certification, or formal proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly convex planar polygons with independent boundary samples: per-edge probabilities strictly positive and fixed, uniform conditional sampling on each selected edge. No claim of optimal within-edge density, finite-sample allocation optimum, adaptive policy, or higher-dimensional analogue. The finite-n expression has an exponentially small rather than zero error. Historical priority remains subject to further verification.
title: Optimal edge allocation and independent corner-area limits for polygonal boundary hulls
